Chief AI Research Officer The Opportunity: 
 AI is reshaping how organizations operate, how missions are executed, and how enduring technical advantages are created. We are seeking a Chief AI Research Officer to establish and lead a focused AI research cell that anticipates consequential shifts in AI and converts frontier research into differentiated intellectual property, mission-ready met hods, authoritative technical perspectives, and measurable value for our businesses and clients.
  
 Reporting to the Office of the President, you will set the enterprise AI research agenda, sponsor rigorous technical investigations, and translate findings into reusable met hods, evaluations, selective thesis-proving prototypes, publications, and investment recommendations. This is not a delivery-management or on-demand demonstration role. It is an enterprise leadership position for a recognized technical authority who can connect scientific rigor, mission needs, market insight, and adoption pathways to create durable advantages.
  
 What You’ll Work On: 
 Maintain a view of foundational shifts while continuously sensing urgent developments.
 Select a focused portfolio of high-consequence research questions based on mission relevance, differentiation, client demand, technical feasibility, and a credible path to adoption.
 Partner with business, product, Sof tware House, engineering, cyber, and mission leaders to transition validated findings into offerings, product roadmaps, reference architectures, reusable components, capture strategies, and AI-enabled mission workflows.
 Lead an integrated research portfolio spanning model and agent evaluation, adversarial testing, secure deployment, human oversight, provenance, resilience, and unintended consequences.
 Establish shared research questions and evidence standards while partnering with teams that own operational governance, compliance, production evaluation, and delivery.
 Create a repeatable research-to-publication pipeline for major reports, benchmark studies, rapid technical perspectives, conference participation, and executive briefings.
 Work with communications and market leaders to turn credible findings into distinctive, evidence-based points of view.
 Convene a lightweight AI research council of senior researchers, principal engineers, mission architects, technical fellows, and business representatives to identify shared questions, review the portfolio, connect talent and assets, and accelerate adoption without duplicating existing leadership structures.
  
 Join us. The world can’t wait.
  
 You Have: 
 Experience setting and leading an enterprise, government, academic, or industry AI research agenda, and advising senior executives on technology strategy, investment priorities, partnerships, and technical risk
 Experience across modern AI, machine learning, generative AI, foundation models, or autonomous and agentic systems
 Experience translating frontier research into validated met hods, evaluations, intellectual property, products, mission capabilities, or business opportunities
 Experience leading senior researchers or research engineers, and directing a focused portfolio of high-risk, high-value technical work
 Experience in AI security, safety, assurance, model or agent evaluation, adversarial testing, or t rus tworthy autonomy
 Experience with influential technical publications, patents, benchmarks, or conference leadership
 Ability to communicate complex technical findings clearly to executive, technical, mission, and client audiences
 Ability to build alignment and drive adoption across a complex matrixed organization without relying on direct authority
 Top Secret clearance
 Bachelor’s degree in CS, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a Science field
  
 Nice If You Have: 
 Experience applying AI research to national security, defense, intelligence, civil government, or other mission-critical environments
 Experience with multimodal systems, physical AI, open-weight or edge models, model economics, human-agent operations, or secure AI deployment
 Experience building partnerships with universities, research laboratories, technology companies, venture-backed firm s, or government research sponsors
 Experience creating research-to-publication and research-to-adoption operating models
 TS/SCI clearance
 Doctorate degree in CS, Engineering, Mathematics, Statistics, or a related technical field
  
 Clearance: 
 Applicants selected will be subject to a security investigation and may need to meet eligibility requirements for access to classified information; Top Secret clearance is required. 
  
 Compe nsa tion: 
 At Booz Allen, we celebrate your contributions, provide you with opportunities and choices, and support your total well-being. Our offerings include health, life, disa bility, finan cia l, and retirement benefits, as well as paid leave, professional development, tuition assistance, work-life programs, and dependent care. Our recognition awards program acknowledges employees for exceptional performance and superior demonstration of our values. Full-time and part-time employees working at least 20 hours a week on a regular basis are eligible to participate in Booz Allen’s benefit programs. Individuals that do not meet the threshold are only eligible for select offerings, not inclusi ve of health benefits. We encourage you to learn more about our total benefits by visiting the Resource page on our Careers site and reviewing Our Employee Benefits page.
  
 Salary at Booz Allen is determined by various factors, including but not limited to location, the individual’s particular combination of education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience , as well as contract-specific affordability and organizational requirements. The projected compe nsa tion range for this position is $275,000.00 to $445,000.00 ( annualized USD ) . The estimate displayed represents the typical salary range for this position and is one component of Booz Allen’s total compe nsa tion package for employees. This posting will close within 90 days from the Posting Date.
  
 Work Model 
 Our people-first culture prioritizes the benefits of collaboration, whether it occurs in person or virtually. To support e nga gement and effective communication, employees working virtually are generally expected to have their cameras on during meetings.
 Remote: If this position is listed as remote , there may still be occasions when you are required to work in person at a Booz Allen or customer facility.
 Hybrid: If this position is listed as hybrid , you will be expected to work from a Booz Allen facility frequently, in alignment with leadership expectations and the needs of the role. You may also be required to work from or visit a customer facility.
 Onsite: If this position is listed as onsite, work will primarily be performed at a Booz Allen office or customer facility, where employees will collaborate directly with colleagues and customers as required by the role.
 
 
 Identity Statement 
 As part of the hiring process, we will ask you to complete an identity verification process that leverages advanced biometrics and artificial intelligence to ensure authenticity and protect against identity fraud. You are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud. 
 
 Candidate AI Usage Policy 
 AI is a part of our daily work at Booz Allen, and we are committed to the responsible and ethical use of AI tools. However, we want to ensure a fair candidate process based on your own skills and knowledge. As part of this commitment, the use of artificial intelligence (AI) or other tools to assist with responses during interviews (whether in-person or virtual) is prohibited unless permission is explicitly provided . 
 
 Commitment to Non-Discrimination 
 All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state, local, or international law.
